entities.summary: Akpene Diata Hoggar is a Ghanaian entrepreneur, blogger, social activist and model. In 2018, she won the Miss Universe Ghana title by representing Volta Region. Later, she represented Ghana in the same contest at the international level in Bangkok, Thailand.
